assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias.
The service directly addresses the clinical indication note's documented need to correlate intermittent symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
